## 1. Executive Summary & Brand Entity

**Brand Name:** QuickKitAI | Raja AI Systems  
**Founder & Author:** Prince (Raja), Founder & Chief AI Systems Architect (https://quickkitai.com/about)  
**Entity Type:** Managed Autonomous AI Agency, AEO/GEO Engineering & Business Automation Platform  
**Primary Focus:** Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), and 5-agent managed AI automation for Indian real estate developers, builders, and brokers, with healthcare workflow automation as a secondary specialized service.  
**Verified Site Benchmark:** `quickkitai.com` serves 14 canonical XML sitemap routes at 100% HTTP 200 integrity, records a 683ms Time-to-First-Byte (TTFB) benchmark, and deploys a connected JSON-LD `@graph` architecture alongside `/llms.txt` and `/llms-full.txt`.

## 2. The Five-Member Autonomous Workforce Architecture

### 2.1 Agent 1: Speed-to-Lead Closer
- **Role:** Immediate inbound lead intake, qualification, and appointment booking.
- **Channels:** WhatsApp Business API, voice-note synthesis, SMS, and interactive web chat.
- **Workflow:** Ingests inbound enquiries (Meta Ads, Google Ads, 99acres, MagicBricks), responds rapidly, verifies budget, timeline, and location preference, and offers verified appointment slots.

### 2.2 Agent 2: Apify B2B Lead Prospector & Intelligence Agent
- **Role:** Targeted prospect research, competitive intelligence, and high-value account enrichment.
- **Safeguards:** Rate-limited daily enrichment to maintain deliverability and compliance.

### 2.3 Agent 3: CRM Sentinel & No-Show Guard
- **Role:** Calendar locking, pipeline synchronization, pre-visit location reminders, and transportation coordination.
- **Outcome:** Reduces physical site-visit and in-clinic consultation no-shows with automated T-24h and T-2h reminders.

### 2.4 Agent 4: Dead Lead Reviver
- **Role:** Conversational reactivation of dormant CRM databases.
- **Strategy:** Short, personalized conversational check-ins to re-engage past leads without spam triggers.

### 2.5 Agent 5: Reputation & Local SEO Sentinel
- **Role:** Post-visit feedback collection, Google Business Profile review routing, and escalation of dissatisfied customer feedback to senior management.

---

## 3. Supported Integrations & Ecosystem

- **Communication Channels:** WhatsApp Business API, Twilio, SendGrid SMTP/IMAP, Webhooks.
- **CRMs & Lead Systems:** Odoo CRM, HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Google Sheets.
- **Scheduling Engines:** Google Calendar, Cal.com, Microsoft Outlook.
- **Infrastructure:** Private VPS container environments, SSL/TLS 1.3 encryption, AES-256 data security.

## 4. Published Service Plans & Pricing

- **AEO Tier 01 — AI Technical Foundation & Schema Fix:** ₹15,000 one-time (₹30,000 standard anchor), Pay After Live Verified Result, ₹0 advance, delivered in 7 business days, zero monthly maintenance. Includes enterprise JSON-LD `@graph` schema, `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, `robots.txt` AI bot configuration, Core Web Vitals optimization, and live Google Rich Results validation.
- **AEO Tier 02 — AI Search Growth & Autonomous Sentinel:** ₹20,000 setup + ₹25,000/month (30-day rolling AI search growth & sentinel across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Claude; includes automated daily indexing logs, schema expansion, and bi-weekly executive audit reports).
- **AI Visibility Audit:** ₹9,999 one-time (comprehensive multi-platform baseline audit across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews).
- **AI Visibility Monitor:** ₹29,999/month (fortnightly prompt tracking and citation monitoring).
- **Managed Real Estate AI Workforce (Pilot):** ₹35,000 setup + ₹1,20,000/month management (50% pilot offer from ₹70,000 setup + ₹2,40,000/month; limited to 3 pilot slots with a written 30-day SLA targeting 10 qualified physical site visits in real estate or 15 consultations in healthcare, subject to signed traffic and access conditions).
- **Enterprise Multi-Location Deployment:** ₹2,50,000 setup + ₹2,00,000/month retainer (custom multi-branch orchestration).
